contracts: (Aggregate status equals invalid whenever required matrix evidence is absent or unexecuted.) AND (All applicable Consumers restore Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.) AND (For any required stale matrix evidence, validator exits with an invalid aggregate status and identifies the stale artifact; no valid aggregate is emitted.) AND (Fresh-checkout semantic verdict equals the reference verdict and pinned-input provenance is complete.) AND (The fresh-checkout run emits a coverage result and equality assertion against the pinned reference; the altered-input selector produces a deterministic failure.) AND (仅当 fresh-checkout identities、pinned inputs、重建结果及 reference Exact Cover 全部匹配且回执可追溯时终止为成功，否则为 stale/evidence-invalid/coverage failure。) AND (存在任一基础设施失败或不可执行 case 时，且仅此时，aggregate terminal status 为 invalid 并包含对应 case identity/reason；不得输出 valid。) AND (每个适用 Consumer 均有四步有序真实调用记录，且最终 route identity、verdict、diagnostic 与 Prior baseline 相同。)
selector_intents: Alter a pinned input or reference coverage result so the fresh-checkout replay differs; the replay validator must fail deterministically.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The replay report records the fresh-checkout coverage result and an equality comparison to the pinned reference result. Expected: Running the evaluation from a fresh checkout with the pinned inputs produces a coverage result byte-for-byte equal to the reference coverage result.
